task: Assess this role against the candidate's recorded work preferences using only the supplied sources. Explain each preference judgment and recommend a supported next step.

sources.text: This position is 24–28 paid hours per week. Required live overlap is 13:00–17:00 Europe/Zurich on each scheduled workday.
Work is fully remote from within Switzerland.
Compensation is prorated by contracted hours; no annual base range is published.

preferences.text: I require a contract between 24 and 28 paid hours per week, inclusive.
I can attend required live meetings from 12:00 to 17:00 Europe/Zurich, inclusive, and not later.
I prefer an annual base amount of at least CHF 100,000 at the agreed part-time hours.
